one_sentence_story: Trying harder to fall asleep backfires by activating a mental wakefulness monitor, whereas spending 5 minutes writing tomorrow's concrete to-do list on paper cuts objective sleep onset from 25.1 minutes down to 15.8 minutes.
so_what_for_you: Keep a physical paper pad beside your bed and spend five minutes offloading tomorrow's exact errands so your brain's unpaid night watchman can clock out.

jargon_map.plain: memory center keeping unfinished tomorrow tasks active
